title: PFGM++
paper_title: PFGM++: Unlocking the Potential of Physics-Inspired Generative Models
core_mech: PFGM++ 用可调增广维度 D 的 Poisson 电场统一 PFGM 与 diffusion，而不是固定高斯前向噪声过程。
core_mech_en: Embeds N-dimensional data on the z=0 hyperplane of an N+D augmented space and learns the high-dimensional Poisson electric field lines, unifying PFGM (D=1) and Diffusion (D→∞).
input_desc: 训练数据 x∈R^N；采样时为 N+D 维简单先验状态
input_en: Training data x ∈ R^N embedded in R^{N+D}; hemispherical prior samples at large radius r_max during generation
output_desc: 沿学习电场 ODE 流回数据超平面的生成样本
output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned augmented electric field ODE back to the z=0 hyperplane

source.title: PFGM++
notes: License conditions exceed this project's MIT grant. Keep this upstream source under its own terms; this registry does not vendor or relicense it.

adapter.name: PFGM++
adapter.mechanism: A Beta(N/2,D/2) radial perturbation law and EDM-preconditioned denoising learn the finite-D augmented Poisson field.
limitations: Finite augmented dimension D=64 and compact network; original PFGM corresponds to D=1, not a D-to-zero limit; no full ODE sampler.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
